music.description: slowed dark ambient A-minor synth pad (-37 cents detuned) with 64.6 Hz C2 sub-bass in Act 2
music.how_it_follows_the_story: Uninterrupted 21.8s 8-bar A-minor pad cycle across 3 mix acts: (1) 0:00.0-0:42.8 high-passed stereo pads (sub-bass -45 dB) under town lore and treehouse pact; (2) 0:42.8-2:10.8 64.6 Hz C2 sub-bass swells +22 dB (pads +6 dB) on 'it's not you' (0:43.0), holding dread through blowing out the lantern (1:19.8), whispered 'Thunderbird' (1:43.6), and bark-trapped kids (2:00.0-2:07.2); (3) 2:10.8-2:37.0 sub-bass strips out (-40 dB) on 'so they could take me' as bark seals Eli, leaving hollow upper pads for fake Eli's return and final plea to Lily (2:34.1-2:36.9).

ambience: none — completely dry vocal over stereo synth pad; zero wind, crickets, footsteps, crowd noise, or fire crackle.
sync_with_picture: ~110 clause-driven cuts with zero SFX whooshes/stingers: rapid hook cuts hit woods (0:00.0), '13' cake (0:00.7), and dusk lantern (0:01.6); +22 dB sub-bass enters on treehouse pact (0:42.8); 1:19.8 lantern blowout lands in eerie foley-free silence; close-ups sync to whispered 'Thunderbird' (1:43.6) and Maya mouthing 'Run' (2:06.7); sub-bass exits at 2:10.8 as bark seals Eli.
faces_and_mouths: Static 2D decals during narration, toggling open/closed 2D mouths on in-scene lines (adult 0:08.8, pact 0:41.0 & 1:03.0, clone 'Thunderbird' 1:43.5, bark-trapped kids 1:57.5, Maya mouthing 'Run' 2:04.0-2:06.8); blank grey clone head (1:35.4) grows Eli's eyes/grin (1:41.3), and fake Eli flashes a sinister smirk hugging Mom (2:21.0).
comedic_or_emotional_timing: Pure creepypasta contrast inside breathless pacing: hushed 'swapped' (0:25.7) undercuts 0:22.7 party cheer; clustered 0.2-0.3s pauses (1:37.0-1:41.1) set up aspirated whisper 'Thunderbird' (1:43.6); silent moving lips pay off on whispered 'Run' (2:06.7); 0.2s dip (2:25.2) sets up shrill 'Welcome back!' (2:26.0) crushed by deadpan 'Nobody ever notices' (2:26.8).
first_3_seconds: Urgent teen TTS at 0:00.1 ('In my town, when you turn 13, you spend one night alone in the woods') over eerie detuned stereo pads (-29 dB Side) across three cuts: woods lantern (0:00.0), '13' birthday cake (0:00.7), and worried dusk close-up (0:01.6).
ending: Hard-cuts at 2:37.0 0.1s after 'don't let it go out' (2:36.9) over hollow upper pads (-22.8 dB into -26.7 dB at 0:00.0); because sub-bass stripped out at 2:10.8 to match 0:00.0-0:42.8, the loop is seamless.
mix: Dark creepypasta mix (-14.0 LUFS, LRA 2.4 LU, +0.1 dBTP): dry mono voice (-16.9 dB Mid, 55.7% in 250 Hz-4 kHz) sits 7-13 dB above wide stereo pad (-24.0 dB Side, 1.9% >4 kHz), with 64.6 Hz sub-bass in 0:42.8-2:10.8 and four ~40s TTS chunk-boundary fry warbles (0:29.8, 1:09.8, 1:50.0, 2:29.8).
why_the_sound_works: Pause-trimmed narration (no gap >0.3s across 2:37.0) holds retention on a 157s creepypasta without meme SFX.
Zero foley or jump-scares makes whispered 'Thunderbird' (1:43.6) and 'Run' (2:06.7) unsettlingly intimate.
+22 dB 64.6 Hz sub-bass swell (0:42.8-2:10.8) and strip-out (2:10.8) subconsciously score the 3-act dread.
Single-voice prosody swings—uncanny ~383 Hz 'Welcome back!' vs. hushed dread—echo the doppelganger theme.
